'''Onie Arkmen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|native]] to<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was a participant of the party scene on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Arkmen,<ref name="AOTC" /> an eligible bachelorette,<ref name="Ladies">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/06/imageattack20020621.html|series=Image Attack|text=Ladies of the Outlander}}</ref> visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> During the visit, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Arkmen, with a drink in hand, walked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] searching for Wesell. While the bounty hunter prepared to ambush Kenobi, Arkmen accompanied herself with two patrons&mdash;a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] and a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Arkmen had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light skin, dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="Databank" /> and was considered otherworldly.<ref name="Ladies" /> During her visit to the nightclub, the woman wore shiny silver [[Clothing/Legends|shorts]], a chain-mail top,<ref name="Databank" /> and golden high heels.<ref name="Chronicles" />
==Behind the scenes==
Onie Arkmen first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Arkmen was portrayed by an uncredited extra in the Outlander Club scenes<ref name="AOTC" /> shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was first shown when the actor playing Arkmen, in costume, introduced the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Episode II]] behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/13.html|series=On Location|text=Part 13 - Ready for my Digital Close-Up}}</ref> The episode, "Ready for my Digital Close-Up," released on [[October 24]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> Arkmen first received her name in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>
